title: PPA: https://launchpad.net/~ahasenack/+archive/ubuntu/openssh-purge-fix/+packages
description:
PPA: https://launchpad.net/~ahasenack/+archive/ubuntu/openssh-purge-fix/+packages
DEP8: a mix of GREEN and INTERNAL SERVER ERROR from launchpad

Counterpart to https://code.launchpad.net/~ahasenack/ubuntu/+source/openssh-gssapi/+git/openssh-gssapi/+merge/512698

Regarding the fix itself, the non-gssapi packages must check for the gssapi "canary", and vice-versa. Or in other words, if you have both branches checked out from their respective remotes:

$ git diff stonking-openssh-gssapi-fix-purge stonking-openssh-fix-purge -- debian/openssh-{client,server}{,-gssapi}.postrm
diff --git a/debian/openssh-client-gssapi.postrm b/debian/openssh-client.postrm
similarity index 79%
rename from debian/openssh-client-gssapi.postrm
rename to debian/openssh-client.postrm
index 4b54c4e17..9c3533ce0 100644
--- a/debian/openssh-client-gssapi.postrm
+++ b/debian/openssh-client.postrm
@@ -1,8 +1,8 @@
 #!/bin/sh
 set -e

-if [ -e /usr/lib/tmpfiles.d/openssh-client.conf ]; then
-       echo "openssh-client is installed; doing nothing."
+if [ -e /usr/lib/tmpfiles.d/openssh-client-gssapi.conf ]; then
+       echo "openssh-client-gssapi is installed; doing nothing."
        exit 0
 fi

diff --git a/debian/openssh-server-gssapi.postrm b/debian/openssh-server.postrm
similarity index 89%
rename from debian/openssh-server-gssapi.postrm
rename to debian/openssh-server.postrm

--- a/debian/openssh-server-gssapi.postrm
+++ b/debian/openssh-server.postrm
@@ -1,8 +1,8 @@
 #!/bin/sh
 set -e

-if [ -e /usr/lib/tmpfiles.d/openssh-server.conf ]; then
-       echo "openssh-server is installed; doing nothing."
+if [ -e /usr/lib/tmpfiles.d/openssh-server-gssapi.conf ]; then
+       echo "openssh-server-gssapi is installed; doing nothing."
        exit 0
 fi

I tried to keep the test similar to the openssh-gssapi one. This is the diff between the openssh and openssh-gssapi purge test (I'm not super happy with this test yet, I feel like trying to make it generic made it more complicated than it could be):

index 0000000..c263c81
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/tests/purge-keeps-config-with-counterpart
@@ -0,0 +1,68 @@
+#!/bin/sh
+set -e
+
+cleanup() {
+    result=$?
+    if [ ${result} -ne 0 ]; then
+        echo "## Something failed"
+        echo
+        echo "## openssh packages installed:"
+        dpkg -l | grep openssh
+        echo
+        echo "## contents of /etc/ssh:"
+        ls -la /etc/ssh
+        echo
+    else
+        echo "## Test passed"
+    fi
+    rm -f "${PURGE_LOG}"
+}
+
+trap cleanup EXIT
+
+# Packages to install first; they take over the config of PURGE_PKGS
+COUNTERPART_PKGS="openssh-client-gssapi openssh-server-gssapi"
+# Packages expected to be in rc state, then purged.
+PURGE_PKGS="openssh-client openssh-server"
+SKIP_SUFFIX="-gssapi"
+# Canary files that must survive the purge
+CANARY_CONFIG_FILES="ssh_config sshd_config ssh_host_ed25519_key ssh_known_hosts"
+PURGE_LOG=$(mktemp /tmp/purge.log.XXXXXX)
+
+echo "## Installing counterpart packages: ${COUNTERPART_PKGS}"
+apt-get -y install ${COUNTERPART_PKGS}
+echo
+
+for pkg in ${PURGE_PKGS}; do
+    echo "## Checking that ${pkg} is in rc state"
+    dpkg -l "${pkg}" | grep -E "^rc[[:blank:]]+${pkg} " || {
+        echo "## ${pkg} is not in rc state"
+        exit 1
+    }
+    echo
+done
+
+# the client's postrm purges this
+echo "localhost ssh-ed25519 AAAA" > /etc/ssh/ssh_known_hosts
+
+echo "## Purging ${PURGE_PKGS}"
+apt-get -y purge ${PURGE_PKGS} | tee "${PURGE_LOG}"
+echo
+
+for pkg in $PURGE_PKGS; do
+    echo "## Checking that the ${pkg} postrm skipped the purge"
+    grep "${pkg}${SKIP_SUFFIX} is installed; doing nothing" "${PURGE_LOG}"
+    echo
+    echo "## Checking that the ${pkg} package is uninstalled"
+    dpkg -l | grep "${pkg} " && {
+        echo "## ${pkg} is not uninstalled"
+        exit 1
+    } || :
+    echo
+done
+
+for f in $CANARY_CONFIG_FILES; do
+    echo "## Checking that /etc/ssh/${f} still exists"
+    ls -la "/etc/ssh/${f}"
+    echo
+done
